device: freight rolling stock running gear and electrical systems
failure_mode: in-service mechanical or electrical equipment failure
failure: Documented recurring problem 'rolling-stock mechanical/electrical equipment failure' (FRA cause family E): 3 of 25 FRA Form 54 accidents in the retrieved window stem from equipment causes. Causes observed: 'Draft gear/mechanism broken or defective (including yoke)'; 'Journal (roller bearing) failure from overheating'; 'Other coupler and draft system defects, (CAR) (Provide detailed description in narrative)'; speeds 7–37 mph. LIMITS STAMPED INLINE: carrier-reported; cause codes are classifications, not proven root causes; above-threshold events only (Art. XXI.5 analog).
constraint: Failure detection must catch degradation before en-route failure at mainline speeds; wayside or onboard solutions must tolerate freight duty cycles, dust/moisture exposure, and intermittent power.
